The '''''MedStar''-class frigate''' was a medical supply ship commissioned during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="MBS" />

==History==
The class was used primarily as a dispensary, ferrying supplies between large bases and the many [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|RMSUs]] scattered around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The frigates also acted as mobile hospital units themselves, making them quite expensive for ships their size, prohibitively so to some. Despite this, the ravages of the Clone Wars forced the Galactic Republic to order more ships.<ref name="MBS" />

The class was often used alongside [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigates]], which were more heavily armed and served as their escorts. Despite this, the Republic generally banked on the ''MedStar''-class ships being left alone due to their status as hospital ships.<ref name="TCWCG" />

Later on, ''MedStar''-class frigates served in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="DSn" />
